alternatives.finding: Complete public listing contains only float32 small/large, each version 1/latest. No official fp16/int8 image-embedder variant found. quantize affects output embeddings, not weights.

alternatives.risk: Classifier output is not an embedding. Need validated intermediate-output export/model conversion. Stock LiteRT.js 2.5.3 smallest compat WASM is 9,334,181 raw bytes and has separate loading/CSP adapters; not obviously smaller than TFJS route.

alternatives.name: ONNX Runtime custom minimal build
alternatives.risk: Stock 1.30.0 CPU SIMD threaded WASM is 14,239,897 raw bytes. A reduced-operator minimal build is supported but needs ORT conversion/custom toolchain and new browser tests; not an easy small prebuilt replacement.

instance.usage:
## Origin

This model is based on [google/imagenet/mobilenet_v1_025_224/feature_vector/3](/models/google/mobilenet-v1/TensorFlow1/025-224-feature-vector/2).

This model has been automatically converted using the [TF.js converter](https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs/tree/master/tfjs-converter).

## Example use
This model can be loaded using TF.js as:

```javascript
tf.loadGraphModel("${URL}", { fromTFHub: true })
```

licenseEvidence.note: Model license is independently declared by the exact official model instance; it is not inferred from runtime licensing. API response is mutable; record this snapshot, do not require future API body hashes to be unchanged.

model.loadApi: tf.loadGraphModelSync([modelJSON, weightsArrayBuffer]) or tf.loadGraphModel(tf.io.fromMemory({modelTopology: modelJSON.modelTopology, weightSpecs: modelJSON.weightsManifest.flatMap(g => g.weights), weightData: weightsArrayBuffer}))
model.inferenceApi: await tf.setBackend('cpu' or 'webgl'); await tf.ready(); graph.execute(inputTensor, 'module_apply_default/hub_output/feature_vector/SpatialSqueeze'); await output.data(); dispose temporary tensors; L2-normalize for cosine.
